items.title: Visual explainer: Midterms through the lens of the president's party
items.description: Every two years, all 435 members of the US House of Representatives and around one-third of the Senate are up for election. Midterm elections give voters a chance to weigh in halfway through a president’s four-year term. If midterms end up being a referendum on the incumbent administration’s performance, then voters have generally not been impressed. Over the past 80 years, the president’s party has nearly always lost seats in the House, the Senate or both.

items.title: How drought and demand pushed the Colorado River toward crisis
items.description: Water consumption in the Colorado River Basin is outpacing what the river can provide, forcing water allocation cuts in three U.S. states and a reckoning over the future of one of the country’s most vital waterways.

items.title: Patriot missile involved in Bahrain blast likely US-operated, analysis finds
items.description: An American-operated Patriot air defense battery likely fired the interceptor missile involved in a pre-dawn explosion that injured dozens of civilians and tore through homes in U.S.-ally Bahrain 10 days into the war on Iran, according to an analysis by academic researchers examined by Reuters.

items.title: Flights interrupted due to Middle East conflict
items.description: Global air travel remained heavily disrupted as war in Iran kept major Middle Eastern airports closed or severely restricted in one of the sharpest aviation shocks in recent years. Key transit airports, including Dubai and Abu Dhabi in the United Arab Emirates and Doha in Qatar, were impacted as much of the region’s airspace remained closed after U.S. and Israeli strikes killed Iranian Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

items.title: Why are there so many live-action remakes?
items.description: The live-action remake of Disney’s Snow White, starring Rachel Zegler and Gal Gadot, hits theaters Friday. The film is the latest in a steady stream of remakes of original films into modernized “live-action” — though still special-effect dependent — versions. This trend isn’t new; Disney's 101 Dalmatians remake was released in 1996. Since the release of the live-action Cinderella in 2015, the uptick has been palpable. Ten films were released in as many years, five in 2019 alone.
